summary: Add a stationary-wave graph and targeted practice for the visual and experimental parts of the chapter.

improvements.where: note, after the graphical construction in ## Key ideas
improvements.why: The diagram gate flags 9702-8.1.2–9702-8.1.4; learners need to see fixed nodes, antinodes and their separations.
improvements.what: Use graph_sketch to show the two opposite-displacement snapshots of one stationary-wave pattern on a common position axis, with fixed nodes at successive $\lambda/2$ intervals, antinodes halfway between, and one node-to-antinode $\lambda/4$ label. Embed the rendered diagram and explain what stays fixed.

improvements.why: The six core items are short answers and the outcome has little varied experimental practice.
improvements.what: Add one MCQ with plausible distractors about how moving a microwave detector identifies fixed maxima/minima, and one exam-style describe item about producing and identifying stationary waves in an air column or on a string. Include explanations and progressive hints.
